card.name: Mixed words inside drug-label caveats
card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires on scattered tokens such as a digit in CCR5 or *1, or small words like 'a', 'is' and 'known' inside caution sentences.

modes.label: Digits in gene names
modes.description: A number ending a gene or genotype label.
modes.example: Maraviroc is recommended for patients with only CCR<<5>>-tropic HIV-1 infection.

modes.label: Small words in caution clauses
modes.description: A short linking word in the middle of a conditional or warning sentence.
modes.example: may occur in up to 10% of patients with<< a>> history of penicillin allergy.
